commenti.body:
It's been nearly two decades since I've seen Phantasm 2. But it's one of those series which is generally regarded that the quality is basically straight down the line, with the first being the best and it just goes down from there. At least that's what I generally read in the Shudder sub, and I basically agree.

I used to hate this series, but kept coming back to it, and learned to love the first one. You just have to accept the dream state these movies require you to be in. At least with the first one.

I also agree that the Tall Man is an all-time classic villain. Very underrated.

The other thing that the series does well that no other series really broaches is the continuity of the characters. Phantasm 5 is basically a meditation on Alzheimer's, as we've basically grown with these characters for about 40 years.

I struggled through the first Phantasm. The editing and acting was godawful (with Angus Scrimm being the sole exception) in my opinion - what with the constant, unnecessary cuts to the funeral house at random moments. What's your take on this?
